memory_candidates.content: When adding a newly-enforced REQUIRED-field presence check to a shared validator script (e.g. validate-artifact.sh), grep the WHOLE scripts/tests/ corpus for minimal plan/report fixtures that predate the field -- not just the test file that directly covers the validator. In this task, test-validate-artifact.sh's own fixture was updated per the plan's Risk table, but two unrelated sibling suites (test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh, test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh) independently built single-phase plan fixtures asserting zero errors/warnings from validate-artifact.sh, and both newly failed only after a full tests/run-all.sh run post-redeploy surfaced them. A targeted grep for the field's heading text across scripts/tests/*.sh before redeploying would have caught both up front.

plan-file-scope-harvest.sh unions a plan's Files-to-modify paths across ALL phases, not per-phase. A test fixture asserting that one phase's sentinel-only block (e.g. '- none planned') contributes zero paths cannot assert the whole-plan harvest is '[]' if another phase in the same fixture declares a real path -- the correct assertion is that the harvest equals exactly the other phase's contribution, never '[]', when any phase in the fixture has a real entry.
